article.story: STILLWATER, Okla. -- — Bryce Thompson had 23 points in Oklahoma State's 89-79 victory over Wichita State on Tuesday night in the NIT. Thompson also contributed five steals for the Cowboys (16-17). Abou Ousmane scored 13 points and added five rebounds. Khalil Brantley shot 5 for 11, including 2 for 3 from beyond the arc to finish with 12 points. Xavier Bell led the way for the Shockers (19-15) with 24 points. Wichita State also got 21 points and 11 rebounds from Corey Washington. Quincy Ballard finished with 19 points and 15 rebounds. Andrija Vukovic's free throw with 12:44 left in the second half gave Oklahoma State the lead for good at 53-52. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
